name: dumbbell-side-bends.html
instructions:
1. Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a pair of dumbbells at your side.
2. Engage your core and keep your chest up.
3. Slowly bend sideways at the waist toward the dumbbell, lowering it toward your knee.
4. Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement.
5. Contract your obliques to return to the starting position. This is one rep.
6. Complete all reps on one side before switching to the other.
